shortDescription: Russia's leading tanker group Sovcomflot RUS:FLOT reported on Friday second-quarter net profit of $190.1 million, compared to a net loss of $42.1 million in the same period of last year.Sovcomflot's revenue jumped 71% to $581.2 million.
